Class UserFaceRepository

java.lang.Object
com.serinity.accesscontrol.repository.base.BaseRepository<UserFace,UUID>
com.serinity.accesscontrol.repository.UserFaceRepository
public final class UserFaceRepository extends BaseRepository<UserFace,UUID>
Repository class for performing CRUD operations on UserFace entities.

Provides methods to persist and retrieve face embeddings associated with users, enabling face-recognition-based authentication flows.
